note: Follow-up to F261; it confirms U-2026-11-09-lenses-in-contract and supersedes nothing. A required state-store field would break third-party plugins later. The two engine branches found (Polars has no memory limit in the CLI, and the source reader's Polars module check) give a built-in engine nothing a plugin couldn't state once the field exists, and the field is additive. The other engine-name literals in the base move to the engine packages through continuous tidying (#886). #1288 closes once #2344 (PR #2352) and #2345 hold its 1.0 work and #2354 is filed.
